subject: Request: marketplace settlement evidence & net receipts statement (OptimaCloud)
messages:
From: Anita Sharma <anita@optimacloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: June settlement – itemized evidence and VAT reclaim question

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. Our accounting team flagged a variance on the June marketplace settlement (invoice attached) that prevents our collections team from releasing the final payment scheduled for 2026-07-05. The summary: the payout amount on your statement differs from the sum of the daily metering lines we received via the marketplace feeds.

Specifically we see ~€14k missing versus our internal ledger after re-aggregation by SKU and project. To get this cleared we need:
- Itemized meter-level export for 2026-06-01 → 2026-06-25 (CSV or Google Sheet)
- A short "statement of net receipts" showing: gross marketplace charges, marketplace fees, refunds/credits, withholding/tax with breakdown by entity and currency
- Confirmation of which Redwood entity received the payout (legal entity + VAT/Tax ID) so we can process the EU VAT reclaim and apply the correct withholding treatment

I attached our invoice and a sample reconciliation our team prepared. Can you let us know what evidence you can produce and an ETA? Our collections deadline is next week so an interim signed statement would be helpful even if the full metering export takes longer.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Sharma
Head of Finance | OptimaCloud
Anita.Sharma@optimacloud.com
Attachment: optimacloud-invoice-202606.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Sharma <anita@optimacloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: June settlement – itemized evidence and VAT reclaim question

Hi Anita — thanks for the note and the invoice. I’ve looped in Markus (billing ops) and Marissa (CS lead) to run the reconciliation and produce the evidence bundle.

Quick checklist of what Redwood can provide and next steps:
1) Meter-level CSV extract (per-day, per-SKU, per-marketplace-order-id) — we can deliver a gated Drive folder link with CSVs by EOD 2026-06-26.
2) Statement of Net Receipts (templated PDF with signature) — we can produce an interim signed statement for collections by 2026-06-26 morning if you confirm the currency to show (EUR vs USD) and the entity mapping.
3) Entity & VAT information — Markus will confirm which Redwood legal entity received the funds and include the VAT/Tax ID.
4) Delta report — if there’s a mismatch we’ll produce a short delta report explaining adjustments (refunds, marketplace fees, currency revaluation).

Action requested from your side: please confirm the legal entity name and bank remittance date you expect (you mentioned 2026-07-05) and whether your AP team needs our statement notarized or just signed. If you can share a contact for payment collections (name + phone) I’ll include them in the Drive share.

I’ve attached a small sample export showing the columns we’ll include and a proposed Drive folder link for delivery.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Attachment: merchant-usage-sample.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 13:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: June settlement – evidence plan

Thanks — scope and timeline look doable. My plan:
- T+1: generate per-day per-order CSV for 2026-06-01 → 2026-06-25 (will include: date, marketplace_order_id, sku, region, usage_quantity, usage_unit_price, gross_amount, marketplace_fee, refund_flag)
- T+1: produce a one-page interim Statement of Net Receipts (EUR and USD) signed by accounting lead for collections; this will list gross, fees, credits, net payable and the Redwood legal entity (Redwood Inference Inc., Tax ID: US99-222333)
- T+2: compile delta report (if needed) with reconciliation notes and suggested corrective journal entries

I’ll drop the outputs into the Drive folder at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cOptimaEvidence (permissions: view for Anita and Peter).

Attachments: evidence-bundle-plan.docx (brief checklist + sample statement template).

Cc: Marissa — please confirm whether we should include full KV-level traces for any specific marketplace SKUs (that increases export size).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Attachment: evidence-bundle-plan.docx

From: Anita Sharma <anita@optimacloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Choi <peter.choi@optimacloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: June settlement – evidence plan

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the plan. That timeline works for us. Our collections deadline remains 2026-07-05 so the interim Statement of Net Receipts in EUR is sufficient for the AP team; no notarization required but we do need the Redwood legal entity and VAT/Tax ID on the statement.

A couple of small asks to avoid a back-and-forth:
- Please include the marketplace order id (or equivalent) in the CSV so our ledger can map lines automatically.
- On the Statement of Net Receipts, add a short line confirming whether any of the adjustments are due to duplicate metering / late refunds (this helps our VAT team classify reclaimable input tax).
- Please share a PDF copy and the Drive folder ACL to include peter.choi@optimacloud.com and accounting@optimacloud.com.

If you can get the interim statement into our hands on 2026-06-26 morning that should allow collections to proceed while you complete the full CSV export. Appreciate the help — looping Peter for their collections queue.

Best regards,
Anita
--
